meta.description: Pons-labeled Connect-4 policy eval. Moves are 0-indexed columns 0..6. scores are Pons WEAK analyze per column (col0..col6); sign = outcome class (>0 win / 0 draw / <0 loss) from mover's perspective; -1000 = illegal/full column. Every board is DECISIVE: the mover can reach >=2 distinct outcome classes (of win/draw/loss) -> never forced.
meta.opening_source: exhaustive symmetry-unique enumeration to depth 8 + played games
